select proj.*, GROUP_CONCAT(distinct c.contract_status) as contractStatuses, IF(proj.projReviewId IS NULL, 'PROJESTABLISH_STAGE', IF(c.id IS NULL, 'PROJREVIEW_STAGE', IF(GROUP_CONCAT(distinct c.contract_status) != 'SETTLE', 'CONTRACT_STAGE', 'CONTRACTSETTLE_STAGE'))) AS projStage from ( select e.id, CONCAT(e.id, 'ESTABLISH') as `key`, proj_name projName, client_id clientId, IF(pr.id IS NOT NULL, pr.proj_sponsor_user_id, e.proj_sponsor_user_id) projSponsorUserId, IF(pr.id IS NOT NULL, pr.proj_cosponsor_user_ids, e.proj_cosponsor_user_ids) projCosponsorUserIds, biz_dept_id bizDeptId, biz_type bizType, lease_types leaseTypes, create_time createTime, 'PROJ_ESTABLISH' as dataType, proj_establish_status as projStatus, pr.id AS projReviewId, pr.proj_review_status AS projReviewStatus from proj_establish_base_info e LEFT JOIN (select id,proj_review_status,proj_establish_id,proj_sponsor_user_id,proj_cosponsor_user_ids from proj_review_base_info pt1) pr ON e.id = pr.proj_establish_id AND pr.proj_review_status != 'CLOSED' where proj_establish_status != 'CLOSED' and proj_establish_status != 'EXPIRE' union all select * from ( select id, CONCAT(id, 'REVIWE') as `key`, proj_name projName, client_id clientId, proj_sponsor_user_id projSponsorUserId, proj_cosponsor_user_ids projCosponsorUserIds, biz_dept_id bizDeptId, biz_type bizType, lease_types leaseTypes, create_time createTime, 'GROUP_CREDIT_REVIEW' as dataType, proj_review_status as projStatus, id AS projReviewId, proj_review_status AS projReviewStatus from proj_review_base_info t1 where t1.relation_data_type = 'GROUP_CREDIT_REVIEW' and t1.proj_review_status != 'CLOSED' and t1.proj_review_status != 'EXPIRE') r ) proj left join contract_base_info c on c.proj_review_id = proj.projReviewId where proj.projStatus != 'PEND_TAKE_EFFECT' and proj.projStatus != 'CLOSED' and (proj.projReviewId is null or proj.projReviewStatus != 'PEND_TAKE_EFFECT')
and proj.clientId=#{dto.clientId} and proj.projName like CONCAT('%',#{dto.projName},'%') and proj.bizType = #{dto.bizType} and proj.bizDeptId=#{dto.bizDeptId} and proj.projSponsorUserId=#{dto.projSponsorUserId} and proj.createTime >= #{dto.createFrom} and proj.createTime <= #{dto.createTo}
and proj.projReviewId is not null and c.id is null
and proj.projReviewId is null and c.id is null
group by proj.`key`
HAVING GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c.contract_status) = 'SETTLE'
HAVING GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c.contract_status) != 'SETTLE'
order by proj.id desc

select COUNT(*) AS totalCount, COUNT(IF(prId IS NULL, true, null)) AS establishCount, COUNT(IF(prId IS NOT NULL AND cId IS NULL, true, null)) AS reviewCount, COUNT(IF(cId IS NOT NULL AND contractStatuses != 'SETTLE', true, null)) AS contractCount, COUNT(IF(cId IS NOT NULL AND contractStatuses = 'SETTLE', true, null)) AS contractSettleCount, COUNT(IF(projCreateTime > #{dto.addLimitTime}, true, null)) AS addTotalCount, COUNT(IF(prId IS NULL AND projCreateTime > #{dto.addLimitTime}, true, null)) AS addEstablishCount, COUNT(IF(prId IS NOT NULL AND cId IS NULL AND reviewCreateTime > #{dto.addLimitTime}, true, null)) AS addReviewCount, COUNT(IF(cId IS NOT NULL AND contractStatuses != 'SETTLE' AND contractCreateTime > #{dto.addLimitTime}, true, null)) AS addContractCount, COUNT(IF(cId IS NOT NULL AND contractStatuses = 'SETTLE' AND contractSettleTime > #{dto.addLimitTime}, true, null)) AS addContractSettleCount
FROM (select proj.key as projKey, proj.dataType, proj.projReviewId as prId, c.id as cId, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT c.contract_status) AS contractStatuses, MAX(proj.createTime) AS projCreateTime, projName, client_id clientId, IF(pr.id IS NOT NULL, pr.proj_sponsor_user_id, e.proj_sponsor_user_id) projSponsorUserId, IF(pr.id IS NOT NULL, pr.proj_cosponsor_user_ids, e.proj_cosponsor_user_ids) dataType, proj_review_status as projStatus, id AS projReviewId, proj_review_status AS projReviewStatus, create_time AS projReviewCreateTime from proj_review_base_info t1 where t1.relation_data_type = 'GROUP_CREDIT_REVIEW' and t1.proj_review_status != 'CLOSED' and t1.proj_review_status != 'EXPIRE') r ) proj left join contract_base_info c on c.proj_review_id = proj.projReviewId where proj.projStatus group by proj.`key` ) t

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM proj_establish_base_info p WHERE
proj_establish_status != 'CLOSED' and proj_establish_status != 'EXPIRE' AND (client_id = #{clientId} OR transferor_client_id = #{clientId} OR JSON_CONTAINS(lessee_info, JSON_OBJECT('clientId', #{clientId})) OR JSON_CONTAINS(creditor_info, JSON_OBJECT('clientId', #{clientId})) OR JSON_CONTAINS(debtor_info, JSON_OBJECT('clientId', #{clientId})) OR JSON_CONTAINS(guarantee_info, JSON_OBJECT('clientId', #{clientId})) OR JSON_CONTAINS(pledgor_info, JSON_OBJECT('clientId', #{clientId})) OR JSON_CONTAINS(mortgagor_info, JSON_OBJECT('clientId', #{clientId})) )

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM proj_establish_base_info_lib p WHERE
origin_id IN (SELECT id FROM proj_establish_base_info WHERE proj_establish_status != 'CLOSED' and proj_establish_status != 'EXPIRE') AND (client_id = #{clientId} OR transferor_client_id = #{clientId} OR JSON_CONTAINS(lessee_info, JSON_OBJECT('clientId', #{clientId})) OR JSON_CONTAINS(creditor_info, JSON_OBJECT('clientId', #{clientId})) OR JSON_CONTAINS(debtor_info, JSON_OBJECT('clientId', #{clientId})) OR JSON_CONTAINS(guarantee_info, JSON_OBJECT('clientId', #{clientId})) OR JSON_CONTAINS(pledgor_info, JSON_OBJECT('clientId', #{clientId})) OR JSON_CONTAINS(mortgagor_info, JSON_OBJECT('clientId', #{clientId})) )

SELECT * from proj_establish_base_info WHERE proj_establish_status = 'TAKE_EFFECT' and (JSON_CONTAINS(lessee_info, JSON_OBJECT('clientId', #{clientId})) or JSON_CONTAINS(creditor_info, JSON_OBJECT('clientId', #{clientId})) or JSON_CONTAINS(debtor_info, JSON_OBJECT('clientId', #{clientId})) ) order by id desc limit 1
